name: Donkey Kick
summary: A quadruped hip extension that trains the glutes with no equipment.
setup: Start on hands and knees, hands under shoulders and knees under hips.
Keep your spine neutral and brace your abs.
execution: Lift one leg, keeping the knee bent at 90 degrees.
Press the foot toward the ceiling until the thigh is in line with the torso.
Squeeze the glute at the top.
Lower slowly, then repeat before switching.
mistakes: Arching the lower back to kick higher: stop when the thigh aligns with the torso.
Twisting the hips: keep the pelvis level.
Dropping the chest: push the floor away.
